scope: Disposable Mattermost; synthetic test bot and channel callbacks; real HTTP, WebSocket and Mattermost web renderer; no production Gateway/model turn
http_websocket_checks: authenticated real WebSocket snapshot arrives before the REST checkpoint
authorized reconnect readback returns the latest cumulative snapshot
seal persists the preview, publishes close, and fences late callbacks
closed generation, ordinary reader publisher, and foreign generation are rejected
nonmember receives neither private-channel snapshot readback nor its WebSocket events
real task card predates result and finishes terminal (commentary first: false)
real task card predates result and finishes terminal (commentary first: true)
web_checks: real web renderer shows WS-only text and native Markdown before any durable edit
page reload reconstructs the active preview through authorized readback
reconnecting after an offline snapshot restores newer preview text without a REST edit
narrow web viewport renders the active preview
a newer durable edit replaces the active snapshot even without a close event
disabling the companion preserves durable text through the stock renderer
limitations: No fresh inbound production Gateway/model turn
Official mobile app uses durable REST checkpoints; no native mobile stream UI
Transient state and five-minute close tombstones are process-local; single node or sticky routing
Recovery and host-adopted progress remain REST-only
